findings.title: A double tap on any B04 action replaces the toast with the no-op's message, and Undo then does nothing
findings.detail: patterns.md §7's tap guard (`lib/tap-guard.ts`) is imported only by B03's files (`rows.tsx`, `review.tsx`, `skipped.tsx`, `txn.tsx`). No B04 screen uses it. A second tap runs the command again; the fake answers `Already …` with `touched: []`, that message becomes the toast, and its Undo restores a state that is already the changed one. findings.title: The shared command schemas (`packages/core/src/commands.ts`) accept hostile input, and `balance.check` can double-book
findings.detail: No B04 free-text field has a max length (100k-character email, Sen text, friend name, essRef all ACCEPTED); `balance.check` allows 10,000 rows and duplicate `accountId`s. With a duplicate, both adjustments are computed from the same snapshot, so after typing RM14,750.87 the balance is RM14,850.87. `member.set` `grant` takes any safe integer and the balance sums past it (`safe: false`). The UI can't produce these (parseSen caps at RM99,999,999,999.99, one box per account), but B05 turns these schemas into the API's contract.
findings.recheck: Schema probes: 255+ char email, 4001-char Sen text, 61-char friend name, balance.check with 0, 51 or duplicate rows, a grant of 9e15, a 65-char essRef, a 101-char key, a 2001-char setting string: all rejected; boundaries (254, 4000, 60) accepted. The fake refuses a duplicate balance check ("Each account once.", 0 adjustments, balance unchanged) and a second grant past the range (balance 9000000000340, safe). Leftovers in finding 20.

findings.title: `manual?day=` checks the shape of the date, not that it is a date
findings.detail: The router accepts any `dddd-dd-dd`. `2026-13-45` and `0000-00-00` throw inside `new Date(...).toISOString()` and show "Something went wrong / This screen didn't open" (the error boundary catches it, no blank page). `2027-01-01`, `1999-01-01` and `9999-12-31` open the form on a future or ancient day, and a payment can be saved there. Reachable only by a typed or old link; Sen's own buttons carry a valid day.
findings.evidence:
day "2026-13-45"   NO FORM | Something went wrong | This screen didn't open
day "0000-00-00"   NO FORM
day "9999-12-31"   form

findings.title: A no-op answer still offers Undo
findings.detail: Inviting an address already invited says `They are already invited` with an Undo that undoes nothing (the double-tap guard only covers a repeat within 500 ms). Same for the other `Already …` answers.
findings.evidence: toasts: ["They are already invited\nUndo"]

findings.title: Choosing the next file takes down the previous Undo toast
findings.detail: The fix for the stale `Already added` toast calls `dismissToast()` for whatever toast is up, so `Attached to RM64.13 on Ryt Bank` + Undo disappears when the next receipt's file is picked, a few seconds into its six.
findings.repro: Scan -> Done -> Scan tab -> pick a different file.
